id: title:DanielVisca:stop onboarding marking metrics complete make gated scene a waitlist

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional branch that checks if an early access feature's stage is "concept" and its payload contains a survey_id.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow PostHog to collect user emails for waitlists before releasing new features, potentially increasing adoption of unreleased capabilities.

observations.behavior: Records product intent when a user joins a concept-stage waitlist, but explicitly skips this recording for impersonated sessions.
observations.posthog_connection: Could help track genuine interest without false positives from testing accounts; however, no backend implementation or actual submission logic is shown.

observations.behavior: Removes Metrics from several onboarding-related lists including SUPPORTED_TOOL_PRODUCTS and ONBOARDING_USE_CASES additionalTools.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the set of products considered complete during onboarding. This could prevent users from marking themselves as having completed onboarding for a gated product they cannot actually use.

observations.limitations: All substantive changes are in frontend TypeScript and test files. No backend API, database migration, event ingestion change, or shared service implementation is present. The tier relies entirely on inferred behavior rather than demonstrated capability.

review.limitations: All substantive changes are in frontend TypeScript and test files. No backend API, database migration, event ingestion change, or shared service implementation is present. The tier relies entirely on inferred behavior rather than demonstrated capability.
review.reason: Adds bounded UI and configuration support for collecting email addresses while waiting for an early access feature release, with checks against impersonation. It does not demonstrate broader systemic benefit or production readiness.
review.posthog_relevance: Allows collection of contact information before launch, potentially increasing future adoption. Prevents misleading completion status for unavailable features.
review.uncertainty: The absence of backend implementation and tests that exercise real submissions makes it unclear whether this will work end-to-end; no score can account for missing context.
